summary: Iteration 83 - All 5 fixes verified successfully. Backend: 11/11 tests passed. Frontend: All UI features working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 fixes from iteration 83 are working: (1) Customers page permissions respect granular customers.create/edit/delete, (2) Per-user customer assignment via assigned_customer_ids persists and filters correctly, (3) Admin scope filter (All/Own Contacts) works with mine=true query param, (4) Non-admin sees only own+assigned+legacy customers, (5) Footer Add Line buttons in PO/Quotation/Tax Invoice grids, (6) Drag-and-drop row reordering with draggable=true on rows, (7) SearchableItemSelect searches by description and shows it as 2nd line in dropdown.

fix_1_customer_permissions.details: Add Customer button (data-testid='add-customer-btn') visible for users with customers.create permission. Edit/delete buttons respect customers.edit and customers.delete.

fix_2_assigned_customer_ids.details: PUT /api/users/{id} accepts and persists assigned_customer_ids array. User Management dialog shows Assigned Customers section with search, select-all, and clear buttons.

fix_3_admin_scope_filter.details: Admin sees scope filter (data-testid='customer-scope-filter') with All Contacts/Own Contacts options. mine=true query param filters to created_by=admin.id only.

fix_4_non_admin_customer_visibility.details: Non-admin user sees only their own + assigned + legacy (null created_by) customers. Scope filter correctly hidden for non-admin.

fix_5_footer_add_line_buttons.details: PO (po-add-line-footer-btn), Quotation (quotation-add-line-footer), Tax Invoice (ti-add-line-footer) all have footer Add Line buttons in tfoot.

fix_6_drag_drop_reordering.details: Rows have draggable=true attribute. Drag handle on row-num cell. useDraggableRows hook applied to PO, Quotation, Tax Invoice grids.

fix_7_searchable_item_description.details: SearchableItemSelect searches by name + description. Dropdown shows description as 2nd line under item name. Tested with 'steel' search term matching 'Cold rolled steel sheet' description.
